description.value: A full-service riverside resort hotel in Fernie, BC, set directly on the Elk River and just minutes from Fernie Alpine Resort. The property offers hotel rooms, suites, condos, and townhouses, anchored by an indoor aquatic centre with a 166-foot waterslide and the award-winning Tandoor & Grill restaurant serving East Indian cuisine. It is one of the higher-profile year-round accommodation options in Fernie, catering to both winter ski and summer adventure travellers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an actively operating full-service resort hotel in Fernie, BC; the contact page corroborates the OSM address (100 Riverside Way) and local phone number ((250)-423-5000). The site consistently uses the name 'Fernie Stanford Waterslide Resort' rather than OSM's 'Fernie Stanford Resort', which is a discrepancy worth flagging. No bike-specific amenities (secure storage, tools, bike wash, e-bike charging) are mentioned anywhere in the fetched content; the amenities page was partially truncated but focused on the aquatic centre, restaurant, and event spaces — the onsite Tandoor & Grill restaurant clearly confirms nearby evening food.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the property as 'Fernie Stanford Resort' but the website consistently uses 'Fernie Stanford Waterslide Resort'.
Blog page contains apparent SQL injection attack strings in post titles, suggesting the CMS may be under attack or compromised — not relevant to the listing itself.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating hotel with confirmed address, phone, and website. No cyclist-specific amenities confirmed but that is not grounds for exclusion.

Nearby evening food.detail: Onsite Tandoor & Grill Restaurant serves East Indian-inspired dinner menus; also offers a Pizza & Burger Menu

wow_evidence: indoor aquatic centre with a 166-foot waterslide and the award-winning Tandoor & Grill restaurant

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: Riverside resort hotel w/ waterslide + restaurant, ~$150-200
